tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dogs gcod mun sel bzhugs/

na mo gu ru be/ dpal stag lung thang nas phebs don rje zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa'i gsung yin zhu ba 'di'i don dang tshig la dpyad na rje de'i min pa rang 'dra ste/ sprul pa'i sku de spyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin par ma zad/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor lta bu ma yin par/ sku na phra mo nas brtsams te/ sbyangs pa phul du phyin cing*/ sku tshe ji srid bar gzigs rtog nyan bshad gleng sgros kyi dus 'das/ 'chad rtsod/ rtsom gsum mnga' rnyes pa yin par grags pa la 'dir rgya gar ba dang gleng bslang mdzad pa'i khungs kyi yig chung 'di ni/ ched du bcos pa'i tshig go dka' ba sgab sgob tsam ma gtogs/ tshig kyang dbyings mi che zhing tshig lam yang mi legs pa rang 'dug /de las kyang khyad par du brjod bya'i hang ma go ba'i don la 'khrul ba mang du snang bas so/ / skabs don phyi rol pa'i grub mtha'i rnam bzhag la/ bod du 'gyur ba'i dbu tshad kyi skor tsho nas phyogs sngar drangs pa tho re ba yod pa tsho la bod ston tshos blos phar btags nas bshad pa byas pa ma gtogs/ phyi pa rang gi mthong thos ye med pa'i stabs/ sgra pa shes rin sogs mkhas pa che rung gis byas pa'i grub mtha'i rnam bzhag tsho la'ang*/ rang gi grwa sa na yin yin bde bde 'dra ba re bshad na'ang*/ rgya gar na de 'dra ye med pa'i bshad pa zom stong mang du snang ngo*/ /'dir bdag shes rab che ba min yang/ phyi pa'i yon tan yod pa mang po rang dang gleng bslang yang mang du byas/ bstan bcos kyang ci rigs pa mthong ba'i stabs phyogs tsam cha rgyus yod pa lags pas/ 'dir zhu bar bgyid/ spyir rgya gar du mu stegs la sngon rgyang 'phan pa yang byung*/ deng sang med/ ha cang ma rigs ches pa grub mtha' smra ba de re zhig bor/ gzhan rig byed khas mi len/ drag po dang khyab 'jug lhar mi bsten/ grub mtha' gzhan dang ma 'dres pa rang byed pa de/ gcer bu pa'am/ rgyal ba pa yin/

'di la da lta yang rkang tshugs yod/ dzai na maṅgi dang*/ she tam+ba ri zer/ bod la slebs mi yong*/ rig byed kyi rjes 'brang*/ lta ba drug ste/ grangs can/ chur lhung gnyis/ rig pa can dang bye brag pa gnyis/ dpyod pa pa dang rig byed mtha' pa'o/ / dpyod pa pa'i ming can gnyis byung ba/ rnying pa dang gsar pa'o/ /dpyod pa pa dngos ni rnying pa de yin/ de yang thar pa med/ thar pa'i lam med zer bas grub mtha' ches ngan/ deng sang de'i yang grub mtha'i rkang 'dzin med mod bstan bcos po ti yod do/ /dpyod pa pa gsar par grags pa de/ rig byed mtha'i khongs su 'dus/ sam khyī ces pa grangs can te/ rtsa ba thub pa ser skyas mdzad/ pa tañdza li/ chur lhung ste mdzad pa po dang bstan bcos ming gcig /'di yang grangs can dang phyogs mtshungs/ n+ya yaḥrig pa can te/ rtsa ba drang srong gau ta mas byas/ bai she ka bye brag pa ste/ drang srong gzegs zan pas byas/ mi maṃ sa/ dpyod pa ste/ bram ze dza ye mu nis byas so/ / bedan+ta rig byed mtha' ste/ drang sraung rgyas pas byas so/ /rig byed dang rig byed mtha' gnyis mi gcig pa nges dgos so/ /de drug la sngon sde dang sde rigs su chad pa'i rkang 'dzin tha dad pa mang du byung ba kun la grags pa der 'dug /deng sang kun tu rgyu rnams/ dpyod pa pa ma yin pa'i gzhan lnga po gcig tu 'dres par spyod de/ dper na da lta bod na po ti phyi nang zer ba dang 'dra/ deng sang bod pa'i mtshan nyid pa rnams bye smra'i gzhung gi khungs mdzod dang*/ mdo sde pa'i gzhung du rlom pa tshad ma rnam 'grel dang*/ rnam rig pa dang*/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i gzhung dam dum tsam slob kyang*/ phugs kyi gtad so/ /dbu ma 'jug pa la byed kyin 'dug pa ltar/ deng sang phyi pa'i kun tu rgyu slob gnyer ba tsho yang*/ shes rab dang bstun pa'i gzhung lugs lnga po de dag ci rigs pa slob mod/ mthar thug gi blo gtad rig byed mtha' la byed do/

/ de rnams mu stegs rang gi mtshan nyid pa'am mdo lugs pa'i tshab yin/ gsang sngags pa'i/ sgom chen pa dang*/ grub thob pa'i man ngag pa'i rigs can yang mang po yod de/ lta ba lnga po de dag gang rung re dang phal cher lta ba mthun mod/ slob gnyer ba'i grwa sar bcad pa med do/ /de dag sngon gyi mkhas pa'i rjes 'brang*/ sngon mu stegs rang du grags pa de tsho'i lugs yin/ nang pa'i gzhung lugs rnams kyi phyogs snga phal cher de dag yin no/ / phyis kla klo tu ru ska'i lugs 'dzin shin tu mang ste/ de rnams blun po nyid kyi phyir/ dus rgyun du kla klo'i rgyal po ltag khur gyi shed byed/ ma dad pa byung na/ dmag dang 'thab 'khrug gis pha rol 'joms pa'i blo gros 'dra byed pa ma gtogs rig pa'i dgag sgrub kyi 'jug sgo med la/ kri twang la sogs pa mtha' 'khob kyi chos lugs log pa gzhan mang po yang de dang 'dra'o/ /lha dbang phyug gi gzhung dang*/ khyab 'jug chen po'i glu sogs lta ba phal cher chur lhung dang rig byed mtha' pa gnyis dang 'dra la 'di dag la dbu ma thal rang dang phyogs 'dra ba'i bshad pa mang du yod do/ / tsar pa ka dang*/ byā ka ra ṇa pa dang*/ nyi ma pa log pa yang sngon sde byung mod/ deng sang sde ni med/ po ti yod do/ /mu stegs sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa la phyi rol gyur tshad/ gang zag gi bdag 'dod pa sha stag yin/ gcer bu pa dang*/ dpyod pa pa chos rnams byed pos stong par 'dod/ rig pa can pa/ bye brag pa/ rig byed mtha' pa gsum dang*/ lha khyab 'jug dbang phyug gi gzhung rnams byed po 'dod pa kho na yin/ grangs can chur lhung gnyis la byed po 'dod mi 'dod gnyis ka byung*/ da lta mu stegs brgyad char btang ba'i bdun tsam dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug gi gzhung dang rig byed mtha' la brten pas byed pa po 'dod do/ /bdag tu lta bas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba byed/ de'i steng du byed por lta ba bsnan pas lta ngan nyis brtsegs yin/

mu stegs pa'i mang shos gzhung rgyag de pa ri bra dza ka te kun tu rgyu zer ba da lta'i sa n+ya shīr grags pa 'di yin/ bram ze phal cher 'di'i rjes 'brang ngam slob ma yin/ 'di rnams rig byed mtha' dang khyab 'jug gi gzhung 'dzin mkhan no/ / dbang phyug chen po kho na lhar 'dzin pa dzang gha ma dang*/ bram ze sai pa te zhi ba pa bya ba yod/ khyab 'jug chen po kho na lhar 'dzin pa/ baiṣ+ṇa ba zhes kyang zer/ u dā si zer ba'i sde zhig yod/ sāṭaka zer ba'i lha mo u ma kho na lhar 'dzin pa'i sde zhig kyang yod/ dzo gir grags pa 'di rnams thams cad spyir grub thob go rak+ṣa'i rjes 'brang yin/ nang gses grub thob gzhan gyi rjes 'brang yang yod pas sngon thams cad nang pa yin/ bar skabs nas go rak+ṣa dang grub thob so so'i gdams ngag tsho ci rigs pa byed mod/ grub mtha' dbang phyug pa'i gzhung dang grangs can lha med pa bsres pa'i phyi par phal cher 'gyur 'dug kyang phyi ba bcos mar 'dug /da dung nang pa rang yang thor tsam yod/ nang pa dang phyi pa 'di dag chos kyi skad saṃskṛ ta gtso bor byed/ rang bzhin gyi skad kyang yod/ yang dar+bhe sha'am so pi dang*/ ka lan+dhar dang*/ kā dzi dang*/ sa yi ta/ bai ra pam thi zer ba sogs thams cad kla klo yin/ de dag gi bstan bcos rnams yi ge dang skad kyang kho rang tsho'i lugs logs pa zhig yin/ deng sang yod pa'i chos lugs rnams kyi nang nas ngan shos tha shal de pa tsho yin/ yang da lta phyi pa'i lugs la/ ral pa yod na paṇ+ḍi ta ma yin pas khyab pa yod la khad tsam yin/ ral pa can de sgom chen pa'i khungs dang*/ tshangs spyod la gnas pa'i khungs yin/ ral pa can khyim du babs na ral pa breg dgos mgo zlum la tshangs spyod yin min gnyis ka yod/ lar mkhas pa nyung zhing*/ phal cher blun pa gzhir bcas kyang*/ slob gnyer ba tshangs spyod yin min thams cad skra breg pas/ mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad mgo brag tu 'ong lags/

de tsam smos pa ni phyogs mgo thing pa'i phyir/ deng sang gi mu stegs pa'i gnas tshul zur tsam lags/ rgyas par 'bri ma lang ngo*/ / da res kyi shog dril 'di'i tshig las byung 'dug pa ni 'di ltar zhes pa yan chad tshur rgol nas bris pa'i 'bri ba po'i rtsom pa yin pa'i khungs su gda' na'ang*/ yul ka n+ya kus+dza yul dbus rang min/ nang pa'i lugs kyi bram ze'i grong ka ba nye ka'i phyi rol nub phyogs thag rgyang tsam pa yin/ phyi pa'i lugs kyi yul dbus ni gang gā dang*/ ya mu na'i bar la zer bas de'i phyogs la med/ yang ma dh+ya de sa zhes pa yul dbus sgra yangs par byas na nyi 'og rgyal khams spyi ming yin/ yul dbus zhes dmigs gsal smos dgos pa min/ ka n+ya kus+dza saṃ skṛ ta yin/ phal skad ka nu dza zer der skyes pa ni yin shas che/ de na slob grwa med/ deng sang phyi pa'i grwa sa ba na ra shi'o/ / yang rgya gar ba'i skye bo mi nag pa rnams zer ba ltar na/ yul dbus kyi tha snyad gzhan la mi byed/ yul ḍi li nas nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i bar dang*/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i bar thag mnyam pas/ ḍi li kho na la yul dbus zer ba ltar na/ yul ka nu dza shar du 'ong lags/ des na yul dbus ka n+ya kus+dza zer ba 'di cha med rgyus gtam mo/ /ke sho gi ri zer ba 'di'i bu chen gcig /lug lo 'di ka la bod du tshong la slebs 'dug lags/ da lta dbus phyogs de tsho na ka yong ba yod/ rig gnas sogs zer ba dang*/ thar pa thob tshul zer ba 'di yang sde dpon gyi gral 'phros la cal col gang zer ba de ka bris par 'dug /thar pa thob pa'i lam ston pa'i gzhung de rig gnas kyi mchog yin mod/ sgra sogs la thun mong gi rig gnas zer ba lags/ rig gnas byas na sde snod thams cad rig gnas kyi gtso bo yin pa ma go bar 'dug pa ang / de rjes gsung sgros dngos yin pa'i khungs su byas pa la/ 'ching grol dang thar pa'i 'dod tshul dris par/

zhes pa 'dug /tshig don 'di rigs la bod kyi mkhas pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis rtsom pa snga phyi kun las dris pa na zhes sam/ dris pa la zhes 'byung ba ma gtogs dris par zer ba 'di 'dra mi yong*/ mdo rgyud gzhung 'grel gang na'ang 'di 'drar bsgyur ba med/ 'di ni phyis 'byung gi 'jig rten pa'i shags tho dang khra ma sogs la yig spor tsho la tshig 'di 'dra byed pa'i mig ltos sbyar bar 'dug pas chos kyi gtam byed na 'di yang tshig skyon no/ / deng sang gi 'jig rten mi nag pa'i rtsom pa la yong*/ mi che ge mos rdzaung ga ge mo la bslus ham rgyag par tshabs su ma song ba'i tshul mi sgron zer ba 'di rigs sdig can tsho'i lab rigs la yong lags/ tshigs bcad skad gnyis sbyar ba sho sh+lau ka gsum po 'di yang*/ rgya gar gyi mu stegs pa'i rtog ldan blun pos sbyar ba yin na cha ci yod/ phyi pa'i rgyud gzhung ngam mkhas pa'i gzhung ma yin par snang ste/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la tshigs bcad du sbyar phyin sdeb sbyor 'grig dgos pa las/ 'di la sdeb sbyor mi 'dug pas so/ / de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ 'dir tsheg bar brgyad brgyad la rkang pa re re byas 'dug pa la/ tsheg bar brgyad pa'i sdeb sbyor ni mnyam pa'i brit+t-i la rjes bsngags dang*/ mi mnyam pa'i brit+ta la kha sgo yin/ phyed mnyam la tsheg bar brgyad pa med/ dza ti'i sdeb sbyor la ni phyi mo rtsi tsheg bar mi rtsi bas/ tsheg bar brgyad brgyad du nges pa mi yong ngo*/ /rkang pa bzhi po lci yang dang tsheg bar 'dra ba'i sdeb sbyor rjes bsngags la/ lnga yod/ 'dra mtshungs gzhal dpag rkang bkra dang*/ /glog phreng dang ni bram ze'i bu dang*/ /zhes so/ /dang po 'dra mtshungs la tsheg bar brgyad kyi yi ge rnams/ lci yang*/ lci yang lci yang dgos pa la/ bhūtāt+manot+bhabaman zhes pa 'di ni/ lci lci yang*/ lci yang yang yang yang zhes par 'byung ba dang*/

rkang pa gnyis pa/ tin+d+ratabiṣasatsar+yaḥ zer ba 'di/ lci yang yang yang yang sa yang lci lci byung bas so/ / tshig 'og ma rnams la'ang des rigs bsgres na mkhyen 'ong ste thog mar sdeb sbyor 'dra mtshungs ni min no/ /gnyis pa gzhal dpag ni/ 'dra mtshungs go ldog pa ste/ yang lci yang lci yang lci yang lci/ yong dgos na 'di ni gong du smos pa ltar spel ma med pas so/ /gsum pa rkang bkra ni/ gzhung las gal te bha dag ga dag rkang bkra/ zhes pa/ bha thog lci ba lan gnyis/ ga dag ces pas lci ba gnyis te/ lci yang yang*/ lci lci dgos na 'di dang 'gal bzhi pa glog phreng ni/ gal te ma dag ga dag glog phreng zhes/ ma kun lci lan gnyis/ ga gnyis/ lci lci lci lci lci lc-i lci lci/ yi ge lci ba kho na yin na 'di dang ma 'grig /lnga pa bram ze'i bu ni/ bha las ta la ga bram ze'i bu zhes/ bha thog lci/ ta mtha' yang*/ yang lci gnyis te/ lci yang yang*/ lci lci yang*/ yang lci dgos pa las 'dir ma byung bas/ brgyad pa rjes bsngags kyi sdeb sbyor ma yin pa'i tshul de ltar lags/ kha sgo yang ma yin par 'dug ste gzhung las/ rkang pa yi ge brgyad dang po las/ sa na min mtsho las ya kha sgo/ zhes rkang pa re re'i yig 'bru brgyad kyi/ dang po dang tha ma bzhag bar gyi yi ge drug byung*/ drug po gsum tshan gnyis yin pa'i dang po la sa mtha' lci ba dang na kun yang ba min pa zhig dgos/ mtsho ni bzhi'i don yin/ mtsho las/ zhes pas mgo nas bgrangs pa'i bzhi'i pha rol ya thog yang ba yin pa zhig dgos pa/ 'dir bhū zhes pa nas bgrangs pa'i bzhi pa'i pha rol yi ge gsum bhab ma zhes pa 'dug na 'di ni gsum ga yang ba yin pas/ ya thog yang ba ma byung ste/ ya la yi ge phyi ma gnyis lci ba dgos pas so/ /'dir ni rkang pa gnyis pa la/ tin ces pa yar bcad nas/ tratabi zhes pa'i yi ge gsum ka yang byung bas na kun yang ba zhes pa yin/ kha sgo la der na 'byung ba bkag pa dang 'gal/

de rjes ṣas tsar+yaḥ zhes pa byung na/ de rnams bzhi pa'i pha rol yin/ bzhi pa'i pha rol yi ge gsum/ ya thog yang ba ste/ yang lci lci dgos pa las/ 'dir ṣas tsa zhes sa mtha' lci ba yang yang lci 'dug pas so/ / des rigs 'gre ba tshig bcad 'og ma kun la thugs gzhig gnang bar 'tshal/ kha sgo tsam po'am spyi'i mtshan nyid 'di la med pa de ltar lags/ kha sgo bye brag pa'i dang po kha sgo phan pa la/ rkang pa gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i pha rol tu dza dbus lci ba yod pa zhig dgos na/ 'di'i rkang pa gnyis pa la gong du bshad pa ltar sa mtha' lci ba byung ba dang*/ rkang pa bzhi pa'i de'i thad du ma nā di zhes dza dbus lci ba byung bas 'gal lo/ / gnyis pa zlog pa'i phan pa ni/ dza yi zung min brjod rnams 'di ni/ /zhes 'byung bas/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa la/ yi ge bzhi pa'i pha rol gsum la/ dza dbus lci ba dgos na/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ bhabam zhes pa de dza ma yin na kun yang ba yin/ rkang pa gsum pa'i gnas der/ gābalku zer ba yang dza ma yin ta mtha' yang bar song bas so/ / gsum pa kha sgo gya gyu can ni/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i pha rol na kun yang ba zhig dgos pa yin/ 'di'i gsum pa la med/ bzhi pa yang ma tsam po la/ rkang pa bzhi kha'i yi ge bdun yang ba'am/ gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i bdun pa yang ba gang rung zhig dgos na/ 'di la sh+loka dang po'i rkang pa gnyis pa'i bdun pa la tsar+yaḥ

zhes pa'i tsa de yang ba min pa dang*/ sh+lo ka 'og ma tsho la'ang*/ de shī de dang*/ nusmṛtra kyi nu dang*/ muk+ta'i mukra te gsum po yang ba ma yin no/ / yangs ma bye brag pa la/ lnga pa bha yangs ni rkang pa thams cad la bzhi pa'i pha rol/ bha thog lci ba dang*/ drug pa ra yangs ni bha yi dod du ra dbus yang ba dang*/ bdun pa na yangs de'i thad du na kun yang ba dang*/ brgyad pa ta yangs ni/ de'i tshab tu/ ta mtha' yang ba dang*/ dgu pa ma yangs ni de'i tshad du na kun lci ba rnams dgos na/ de dag gang gi'ang mtshan nyid ma tshang ngo*/ / bcu pa kha sgo bla re'i tshan yang ma yin te/ bla re la sa mtha' lci ba gnyis yod/ de'i khongs su bsdu ba la rkang pa thams cad la yi ge dang po'i pha rol sa na gang rung min pa dang*/ rkang pa gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i yi ge bzhi pa'i pha rol dza dbus lci ba dag go /'di dag las/ nabibikra dang*/ walabhe zhes pa tsam sa mtha' lci ba byung yang tshigs bcad gzhan/ tsho bzhi pa'i pha rol dza sogs phal cher la med pas nges med du gnas pas so/ / yang kha sgo bye brag pa'i spyi'i mtshan nyid la ni/ lnga pa thams cad yang ba la/ /gnyis pa bzhi pa'i bdun pa yang*/ /drug pa gang yin lci bar shes/ /lhag ma'i dbyangs rnams nges pa med/ /ces 'di la mi snang ba gzigs pa 'di lags/ de ltar na sdeb sbyor las 'das tshul bshad zin mod/ sngar sdeb sbyor gsan na des khyab 'dug /ma yin kyang bha thog lci/ ya thog yang*/ sa mtha' lci/ ta mtha' yang*/ dza dbus lci/ ra dbus yang*/ ma kun lci/ na kun yang*/ la yang*/ ga lci zhes dang*/ ring po dang*/ blu ta dang*/ 'greng po na ro/ /yi ge brtsegs ma pha rol na yod pa'i dang po dang*/ de dang don gcig pas mthar brten can lci ba yin/ spyir yi ge yang lci la/ rgya gar na sgra gzhung dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ klog slob pa'i skabs te gsum po mi 'dra ba phran bu yod do/ / gzhan yang tshigs bcad sgyur ba 'di la skad dod nor ba yang snang ste/

thog ma bhūtātra dang*/ man dang ut+bha ba/ mtshams sbyar nas 'byung ba rnams las yid 'byung*/ bhūtāt+manot+bhab byas 'dug pa/ bhūtātra ces pa/ nga si atra/ gcig tshig yin pa la/ rnams zhes mang tshig byas pa nor/ 'di na sa tsat+yaḥ zer ba 'di rjes su yig nor byung ba min na/ de spyod do zer bar 'gro shing*/ spyod par 'gyur zer ba min/ bi ṣa ya yul la 'jug kyang 'dir bi ṣa zer bas yul la 'jug pa med/ yang sa zhes pa yig nor byung ba yin/ yang yin snyam na der zad kyang*/ /mnātra/ yid las dang*/ in+d+ra dbang po'i skad dod du byas pa/ in+d+rata byas na/ dbang po kho na nyid kyi don yin/ dbang po 'byung bas zhes bsgyur ba'i 'byung ba'i skad dod med do/ / yid du 'ong zhes pa'i skad dod la/ balgu ces pa 'dug ste/ de 'dra ye ma grags/ lkog gyur gsang tshig shed yin nam/ yid 'ong la mno rā ma/ mnodzñā/ mnopa zer zhing*/ ramya/ kan+ta/ iṣ+ta sogs/ don 'gyur gyi dbang du byas nas/ yid 'ong du bsgyur ba ni mthong*/ phal skad du byis pa la balgu ni zer lags/ yang dweṣa zhe sdang*/ an+yaḥ gzhan a bhiman zhes pa/ nga rgyal yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sdang dang gzhan las nga rgyal zer ba byas 'dug kyang*/ dweṣan+ya byas na zhe sdang las gzhan zer bar 'gro yi/ gzhan las zhes pa'i las kyi skad dod dang don thob yang ma byung ngo*/ / a bhiman ni/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal kho na'i ming yin/ nga rgyal tsam gyi ming ma lags so/ /yang lan 'di las skye zhes pa'i skad dod/ h+mīmāt+dzan+ma zhes pa bris/ upadan dang*/ pa rigrahaḥl sogs dang*/ la yig rkyang pa sogs len pa'i skad dod mang po yod te/ h+mīm len pa'i skad dod du byed pa 'di gang na'ang yod pa ma mthong zhing ma thos so/ /yang prati dang āhar mtshams sbyar ba'i/ prat+yāharaḥso sor sdud pa'i ming yin gyi /'dir prātihār zer/ pratihār ni lan 'debs la zer/ pratihār ni gang du 'gro mi shes/

pra dang atihār yin na/ mang po rang smra phod zer rgyu e yin/ srog rtsol la yang*/ praṇāyamaḥ yin gyi/ prāṇābesha gang na'ang ma bshad/ prāṇābesha byas na srog zhugs zer bar 'gro /bibik+tardzati/ dbyen pa las skyes pa'i skad dod du byas pa yang*/ phyogs 'gro tsam las mtshams ma zin pa te/ bibik+ta/ dben pa pa'i don yin pa/ dzati skye ba dang sbyar na/ dben pa po zhig gi skye ba zhes par 'gro/ dben pa las skyes pa'i skad dod dgos na bibekadzaḥzer ba lags/ ṭiṣ+ta dga' bar bsgyur ba'ang*/ tuṣ+ta dang nor ram sems/ par raṃ paraḥzhes pa yang yang gi skad dod du bsams 'dug kyang ma yin/ gcig nas gcig tu'am/ gzhan nas gzhan du zer ba'i don lags/ des mtshon nas skad dod mi 'grig pa phra mo da dung gzhan yang 'dug go /des na tshig 'di rnams la phyi nang sus kyang yid rton mi 'ong bar nges pa lags so// spyir phyi lugs la yan lag brgyad kyi sbyor ba zer ba'i tha snyad yod/ de'i nang na'ang*/ srog rtsol dang sor sdud kyi ming yod kyang*/ 'di 'dra'i rigs la thun mong ba phyi nang gnyis 'dra ba yang mang po yod/ nang pa'i de nas phyi pas rkus pa'ang yod pas/ de 'dra gang gi'ang rgyu mtshan du mi 'gro/ dper na gcer bu pa la yang*/ bslab pa'i gzhi lnga dang*/ dge ba bcu'i tha snyad nang pa 'dra ba dang*/ d-iṣabha te khyu mchog logs pa la kho rang tsho'i ston pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sangs rgyas zer/ ar+hate dgra bcom zer/ gzhan yang dge slong dang/ mkhan slob sogs sangs rgyas pa dang ming 'dra ba mang du yod/ yang na pa'ang phal cher 'dra ba yod de/ mun rdul snying stobs gsum zhes pa yon tan gsum 'di/ thog ma grangs can gyi gzhung las byung*/ de rjes phyi pa'i gzhung lugs gzhan phal las kyang bshad mod/ nang pa'i rgyud/ rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ sam+pu ṭi dang*/ dpal mchog sogs las mang du gsungs pa lta bu yin/ la lar ming kho na gcig pa dang*/ kha cig tu don yang phyogs 'dra yod do/

/ don ni dbyings nas mi 'dra ba mang mod 'ga' zhig 'dra yang skyon med de/ dge ba bcu bzhi po/ skyon gyi tha snyad gdags su mi snang bar sems zhes pa'i don la nang pa'i blun po mi shes pa mang po dang*/ kla klo rnams bzhin du/ pha rol po'i tshig thams cad rang skyon can 'ba' zhig kho na yin snyam pa zhig sngar nas yod pa'i nyams te/ sh+lau ka gsum gyi nang na skyon med pa tsam la ha las te/ shes ldan dag dpyod cig /ces da dung yid ma ches pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dug pas so/ / skyabs 'gro brjod ma dgos/ spyod tshul la bshad tshod kyi dbang du na/ phyi gzhung la la na skyon rang med/ la la na spyod pa nor ba mang mod*/ da lta lag len byed pa'i dbang ltar na/ bod pa'i dge slong dang*/ phyi rol pa'i daṇ+ḍa dha ra'am/ gcer bu pa'i dge slong gcig bsdur na he he lags/ rang re bod na/ bshad pa byed dus de mi rung*/ de yang mi rung zer ba'i ngang la 'gro/ dngos su lag len 'gel dus/ sdig pa yin tshad rung bar byed/ rang yang byed bslab ston byas nas gzhan yang byed du 'jug /yon bdag grwa rigs sogs kyi sdig pa rlabs chen byas na/ dgyes pa mchog tu 'gyur ba kun la phan tshun thugs rgyus mnga' ba lags pas/ mu stegs ngan pa zer spyod pa'i gleng brjod de rang bzhag na dga' 'dra lags/ rgya gar gyi phyi pa tshun chad byed mi nyan pa'i sdig pa la/ bod pa'i bla ma slob dpon rnal 'byor pa thams cad shin tu dgyes par 'jug pas so/ / yang bdag khas len pa zhes pa 'di yang ha cang rtsings so/ / phyi nang gnyis po lta sgom la khyad chen po zhugs pa rang yin/ de min na gnad gsang phra mo tsam gyis khyad mi thon lags/ yang bar 'dir/ tshigs bcad tshig rkang bcu gcig pa zhig 'brel med du 'byung ba 'di'i/ tshig rkang dang po drug po 'di ri bo dge ldan pa'i grub mtha' la zur zar 'dug /lar yi ge than thun chung ngu 'di tshor yang tshig snga phyi'i 'grel gang yang med par zur za 'di 'dra yong ba de/

pha rol po de pa la shin tu rang thugs snyung ba zhig yod pa'i rtags yang dag der 'dug /'on kyang don la 'khrul gzhi'i kun rdzaub tshad grub ces pa dang sangs rgyas pa yi rtags dang rlom 'chang sogs kyi khog don la/ kun rdzob tshad grub tu khas blangs phyin/ rtags kyi bgag bya bden grub 'gog pa sogs byas kyang*/ skyabs 'gro dang cha lugs tsam ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas par mi 'gro gsung bar 'dug kyang thal ches/ kun rdzob la tshad grub kyi khyab pa ni dge phyogs tsho yang mi 'phya kun rdzob la la tshad grub tu bzhag mod/ des der 'gro na/ bye mdo sems tsam gsum sangs rgyas pa ma yin par thal bar 'gyur na ji skad du/ sangs rgyas chos ni rnam pa bzhir/ /yid 'dod rnams kyis sngon 'dod de/ /zhes pa dang 'gal/ kun rdzob bden pa tshad mas grub par 'dod pa ni/ dbu ma rang stong rnying pa rnams dang tshig khas len la ma mthun kyang*/ tshad ma de kun rdzob pa'i tshad ma tsam du ka 'dod pas/ don steng nas rnying pa tsho dang yang mi 'dra ba tsam med/ 'khrul yul la brten 'khrul ba spong mi nus/ zer ba ni khyab pa med pas 'thad de/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis mdo las/ 'jig rten sna tshogs de bzhin gnas kyang ni/ /'on kyang brtan rnams 'di la 'dun pa 'dul/ /ces pa dang rgyab 'gal du song bas so/ / yan lag brgyad kyi sbyor ba zer ba zhig bshad pa chos skad rnying pa rang yin nam/ nang pa la 'dra dpe blangs/ brtags dka' mod de la yang chos pa'i 'phags lam yan lag brgyad zer ba lta bu'i bshad pa ma gtogs khrid gdams ngag rkang tshugs mi yong lags/ yang dge ldan pa'i chos skad kun rdzob tshad grub dang*/ dpyad sgom gtso bor byed pa la/ rje rang bzhugs dus ni lab lob ma byung*/ sku gshegs nas/ sa skya pa dang*/ bka' rgyud pa thams cad kyis dgag pa shes tshad btang*/ yi ger bris rnying ma ba tshos lhag por lung bstan mang po yang yod/ de thams cad par du'ang bskos zin/

kha gtong dgos kyang dran tshad btang grub dang dgos dgag pa bskyar nas mdzad dgos med lags sam/ yang snga ma rnams kyis ma rnyed pa'i skyon gsar pa gtong rgyu'am/ dge ldan pa rjes ma tsho'i grub mtha' gsar pa yod na/ de tsho la dgag pa bzhin e yod yin/ gzhan da ni dmag 'khrug rang dar phyin/ grub mtha'i dgag sgrub rang yal ba 'dra'o/ / grub mtha'i dgag sgrub byed pa de/ phan tshun gnyis ka btsun pa'i tshul ma shor tsam gyi skabs der yong ba yin 'dug lags/ spyir ni byang chub sems dpa' la skur pa 'debs pa dang*/ chos spong gi las 'di lod shos rang yin pas mtshams med las kyang thu bar/ mdo sde kun las gsungs 'dug pas/ dge ldan pa tshos kyang*/ gzhan thams cad chos min zer ba dang/ gzhan tshos kyang dge ldan pa 'dre rang yin zer ba 'di 'dra'i phyogs la bdag cag ni lar mi the'o/ / gcer bu pa'i lta ba 'dzin 'dis kyang zer ba yang 'brel med cal col te/ gcer bu pa'i lta ba 'dzin pa 'di zer ba'i yul de/ gcer bu rang la zer na ni tshig gi rnam bcad med par 'gyur te/ zhing 'debs pa'i mi'i gdong pa yod pa 'di zhes brjod na rnam dpyad med pa'i tshig tu 'gyur te/ de ni zhing 'debs pa'i mi rang min pa la/ zhing 'debs pa'i ma'i gdong pa gyon pa lta bur go nus par byed do/ /des na 'dir/ gcer bu pa'i lta ba 'dzin pa 'dis byas pas/ gcer bu pa min pa la/ de'i lta ba 'dzin pa go bar 'gyur gyi gcer bu rang la mi zer ro/ /de 'dod na/ gcer bu ma yin la gcer bu pa'i lta ba 'dzin pa de su yin/ chos thams cad bden med du 'dod pa'i dbu ma rang stong pa'o snyam na/ sangs rgyas pa min zer ba dang 'gal/ yang de 'dra'i mu stegs pa cig yod snyam na de yang su/ gcer bu pa ma yin la gcer bu pa dang lta ba gcig pa'i phyi pa de 'dra sngon yang ma byung la/ da lta yang med do/ / yang gcer bu rang la bsams pa'o snyam na tshig skyon gong du bshad/

ji skad du/ tshig kyang sgrig legs mi shes na/ /don bzang smos kyang ci dgos te/ / bya ba lags de la gcer bu pa ces pa/ de rnams kyi lha'am ston pa gcer bur yod pas gcer bu'i lha'i lugs 'dzin pa'i don yin/ de'i grub mtha' pa la lus gcer bur ma nges/ lus gcer bu'i brtul zhugs can dang*/ rgyal ba pa la mu bzhi yong*/ shwe tā mā ri bya ba/ zad byed pa'i btsun pa gos dkar can yang yod pa ni rgyal ba pa yin la/ gcer bu'i brtul zhugs mi byed pa'i mu/ mu stegs kun tu rgyu dang*/ kla klo'i btsun pa gcer bu'i brtul zhugs byed pa tsho de las ldog pa'i mu/ phyogs gos can gos med rgyal ba pa rnams gnyis ka yin pa'i mu/ de las gzhan thams cad gnyis min gyi mu'o/ / chos skad gang la yang 'di 'dra zhig yin snyam pa'i blo rtse gtad mtshams shig nges nas de la dpyad pa byed dgos kyi/ dpyad gzhi gang yin ngos ma zin pa'i ming tsam la brtsad pa ci zhig rung*/ des na 'dir yang gcer bu pa/ gcer bu pa zer ba ma gtogs/ khyad gzhi ngos zin pa'i blo rtse gtad mtshams ci yang ma byung 'dug pa der ma zad/ gcer bu pas yul steng du spros pa 'gog shes zer ba ni/ gcer bu pa shes bya thams cad bden med du 'dod pa yin byas na yong bar 'dug bsams par gda' ba lar gcer bu pa de ltar mi 'dod mod/ khyed la 'di 'dri ste/ 'o na gcer bu nga bdag bden med 'dod lags sam ces so/ /de 'dod na gcer bu pa la sku drin skyong zhing dgongs par bde ba rang zhig yin 'dug /na ning bar lho bal la phebs dus mu stegs tsho dang srid phyogs sgrig pa mdzad pa'i lugs legs rang byung nas gang zag gi bdag med sangs rgyas pa'i dgos nor de nas khong tsho la gnang sbyin mdzad pa rang los yin/ gzhan sngar mu stegs byed la gang zag gi bdag med de med bden rang yin/ de med phyin chos kyi bdag med yongs rdzogs ni ga la yod/

dum bu than thun dang po nas yod par byed/ yang nga bdag bden par 'dod na/ yul gyi steng du spros pa bcad pa ga na yod/ yod med yin min skye 'gag sogs spros pa rnam grangs tsam yin/ nga bdag tu 'dzin spros pa thams cad kyi nang nas ches ma rung shos lags pa kun la grags pa de yin mod/ skabs don gcer bu par yongs su grags pa/ rgya skad du/ dzain margi/ bod skad du/ rgyal ba pa'am/ rgya skad du/ k+ṣayaṇa te bod skad du/ zad byed pa ni/ srog dang gang zag gi bdag don cigade nyid ngo bo rtag la gnas skabs mi rtag pa de bden grub yin zer ba dang*/ sna tshogs snang ba thams cad bden med du mi 'dod pa gcer bu pa'i shes bya don dgu 'dod pas gsal bar rtogs nus so/ / yang mu stegs gcer bu pa yul thams cad med par 'dod pas yul steng du spros pa 'gog shes/ de shes pas/ rnam grol thar lam gyi phyogs su zhugs zer ba 'di 'dra/ sangs rgyas pa yin kyang thar las sangs rgyas pa ma yin kyang thar lam yod zer bar song bas phyi pa la phar 'gyur song ba'i nyams su 'dugasangs rgyas pa'i rkang nas bud pa'i bla bor 'dug pas de la zer rgyu rang zhig mi 'dug go /'di yin pa de sor phreng gi gcer bu pa yang thams cad med ces sgra gsung ba de mig zur la thogs pa'i dran rkyen du 'dug kyang*/ mu stegs sngon byung ba'i gos med pa sor phreng du byung ba de yang*/ thar pa ci med du 'dod kyi/ shes bya thams cad ci med ga la 'dod/ yang spros pa yul gyi steng du gcod shes pas zer ba 'di/ dge lugs pa dang*/ gzhan mtshan nyid pa'i chos skad la la dang mthun rung yin/ yul gyi mtshan ma 'gog pa la ma ltos par/ yul can shes pa'i rtsol ba 'gog pas gnas lugs rtogs par bzhed pa'i bka' brgyud kyi grub mtha' dang ni rgyab 'gal rang du song ba go yi/ de las 'di 'dod ces pa'i de las zer ba rnam bcad bral ba'i tshig go

/ de la kun rdzob tshad grub pa dang*/ gcer bu pa gnyis so zhes bshad ma thag tu de las zhes byung na go ba zhig yong lags kyang*/ spros pa yul gyi steng du gcod shes pas/ de las zhes byas na spros pa bcad pa'i rgyu las grub mtha' 'di 'dod zer bar song*/ rtsom pa mi shes bzhin du brtsams pa la dgos pa ci mchis/ gcer bu sngon shes bya thams cad ci med du ga la 'dod de/ shes bya thams cad ci med 'dod mkhan su yang mi yong ba'i phyir te/ mngon sum dang 'gal ches pas su yang*/ de 'dra la blo gtod mkhan mi yong ba'i phyir ro/ /ci ste snang ba rnams ci med du 'dod rang 'dod na/ de ni skur 'debs chad lta mu med pa rang yin pas/ rnam par grol ba'i phyogs su 'gro ba nam yang mi rung bar ma zad/ rgyang 'phen las kyang phyin ci log tshabs che'o/ / yang ci med thar par 'dod pa ni yong ste thar pa ci med du khas blangs par song dogs nas/ bye smra rnams 'gog pa rdzas yod 'dod dgos pa byung mod/ bod 'dir yang sngon nas da lta'i bar/ dngos med du sangs rgyas zer ba tsho dang*/ rgya gar ba'i dbu ma pa mang po ni 'di'i phyogs su blun pa'o/ /gzhung lugs rnams kyi phyogs sngar blangs pa'i gcer bu rgyal ba pa ni thar pa yang ci med du mi 'dod de/ gzugs can du khas len lags/ lar mu stegs byed la la sdug bsngal las thar pa thar 'dod de/ dbang phyug pa dang khyab 'jug pa la sogs pa'o/ kha cig g.yo ba las thar pa thar par 'dod de/ gcer bu rgyal ba pa bzhin no/ kha cig thim pa dang grogs med gcig pur gyur pa thar par 'dod de/ rig byed mtha' pa dang grangs can lha med lta bu'o/ kha cig shin tu thar pa ste/ thar pa ci med 'dod de/ 'di chad lta'i rigs zhig go / de thams cad thar pa ma yin pa la thar par ngos 'dzin pas nor tshabs chen po yin pa dang*/ khyad par du yang*/ thim pa dang grogs med pa/ ci yang med pa'i thar pa bya ba rnams mi srid pas ri bong rwa'i sdeb yin/

gzhan gnyis po srid mi srid dpyad gzhi tsam yod/ ci ste srid kyang thar pa ma yin no/ /dbye ba gang yang ma go bar kha tho mnam la 'phyar nas/ lkugs rtags ston par ma byed cig /lar nas phra ba'i mi rtag pa dang*/ phra ba'i sdug bsngal dang bdag med gnyis sogs kyi bshad pa 'di/ sangs rgyas kyis rang gis myong nas gzhan la bstan/ sangs rgyas kyi khrid pas 'phags pa gzhan tshos kyang mthong ba yin/ de ka la/ skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsung ba/ bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug ma yin pa zhig gis 'dra dpe blangs nas de 'dra bshad kyang gzhan rgyud grol mi nus te/ gnas lugs de rang gis ma thob pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na/ bod nas o rgyan du 'gro ba'i lam bar gyi skad cha tsam rna thos shod rgyu yod kyang 'gro ma myong na gzhan gyi lam sna mi rung ba bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa la chos skad 'di dag gdod nas ni med par nges/ phyis bcos ma'i rigs rgya bod du byung srid na'ang*/ grol ba'i phyogs su 'gro ba yin rgyu ci yang med pas/ gcer bu pa yi lta ba 'dzin 'dis kyang*/ /zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig po 'di kho nas rang mtshang du ma cig car bstan gda'o/ / da ni gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta dang zhes sogs kyi don la dpyad na nang pa'i gsang sngags kyi sbyor drug dang*/ phyi pa la yod zer rgyu'i sbyor drug de don gcig gyur pa'i bshad par 'dug ste/ nang pa'i sbyor drug la yang*/ bskyed rim kho na'i de yang yod/ rdzogs rim kho na'i de yang yod gnyis ka'i de yang yod mod/ 'dir dus 'khor gyi sbyor drug dang sbyor rgyu'i khungs yin 'dug sde/ dus 'khor sbyor drug la go ba phyogs 'gro yang ma byung ba der 'dug /dbang yul gyi brten gyi 'byung ba dang*/ dbang yul rigs 'dra yod zer ba'ang tshig gi na ya tsam ste rten bsdus pas brten pa sdud nus pa'i rgyu mtshan du mi 'gro na/

rigs 'dra yin pas sdud thub pa de las kyang ma nges pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi pa kun tu rgyu rnams de ltar mi 'dod de/ 'byung ba rnams de kho na nyid yin pas/ bskyed bsdu med pa'i phyir ro/ /dus 'khor sbyor drug la ni/ yul nang du sdud pa'i tha snyad mi byed cing*/ 'byung ba nang du bsdus pa'i rgyu las dbang yul nang du bsdus 'gro bar bzhed pa yang ma yin no/ khams so drug gi tha snyad kyang phyi pa'i sngags brgyud dang sman spyad dag na'ang grags pa med pa mngon*/ nang pa la grags pa yin/ dwangs ma bsdus pas snyigs ma bsdus 'gro zer ba ni su zer kyang mi 'thad/ rtogs pa mtho mor ma song bar dwangs ma lkog tu gyur pa kho na yin pas bsdus lugs ji ltar byed/ sor sdud las dang po nas rgyud la skye ba'i phyir dang*/ 'dir dwangs ma bsdus pas snyigs ma bsdus pa sor sdud kyi sgra don du byas 'dug pas so/ / lar yang dwangs ma phyi nas nang la bsdus pa dang*/ snyigs ma nang du bsdus pa la dgos pa ci yod/ phan yon gang yod/ dbang po dang thig le'i dwangs ma zer ba byas 'dug pa/ dwangs ma gang yin snyigs ma ci yin/ 'byung lngas khams snyigs ma skyed tshul la/ skres pa/ gla ba/ sbrid pa/ bya rnyed/ gnyid/ lta ba nyan pa/ glu gar 'gro sdod sogs bgrang ba ni blun po'i rnam 'gyur te/ de dag ni bya ba'i rnam 'gyur tsam yin gyi lus la sha khrag logs pa ltar khams su gnas su med pa'i phyir ro/ / gal te 'byung ba dang de dag sbyar ba zhig yod rang yod na 'byung ba de'i byed las yin ces ston pa yin mod/ khams su mi 'ong lags/ khams so drug bya ba lus kyi khams yin cing*/ khams kyi don yang*/ rgyu'i don dang*/ dbyings kyi don la 'jug pa'i khams de ma yin/ rtsa khams rlung zer ba'i dus kyi khams de yin mod/ de dag khams de 'dra yin na/ mkhris pa bad kan sogs lus kyi cha shas na gnas pa ltar/

glal ba dang bkres pa dang gnyid sogs lus kyi cha la yod dgos na de dag ga na yod/ lar 'di na mchil ma dang kha chu so sor byas/ bkres pa dang ltogs pa so sor byas/ lta nyan sogs dang*/ mthong thos sogs so sor bgrang ba dang shes rig rnam grangs du ma lus kyi khams su bgrang ba 'di rig pa rnal du med pa'i tshig yin/ bskyed sdud brkyang bskum bzhi byed pa sogs rdzas med gnas skabs la btags yod tsam lus kyi khams la bgrang ba yang blun rtags kho na te de lta na skye rga na 'chi mi tshig sogs kyang lus khams su thal bar 'gyur ro/ / de bden kyang mu stegs lugs bskyar zlos byas pa'o snyam na/ mu stegs mkhas pa rnams de 'dra 'dod pa mi srid pa'i phyir 'di rdzun ma'o/ khyed la 'dri ste lus kyi khams bgrang rgyu yin na/ khams thams kyi rtsa ba khu rdul mi bgrang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ de gnyis dwangs ma'o bsams par 'dug ste/ rdza gog yo bcag gda'/ dkar dmar gnyis la dwangs ma dang 'bring po dang snyigs ma gsum yod pa las/ mngon 'gyur 'di dag snyigs ma yin/ dri chu dang bshang ba sogs kyang snyigs ma rkyang pa ma yin dwangs ma ji snyed yod/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad bris pa na/ 'byung ba rnams las yid 'byung zer ba ni rgyang 'phen gyi 'dod pa ru song*/ 'byung ba las yid dang yid las dbang po 'byung ba'i grub mtha' 'di 'dra phyi pa'i lta ba drug dang*/ gcer bu pa dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa su la'ang med pa rig par gyis shig /yang rgyang 'phen ma gtogs phyi rol pa rnams/ 'byung ba lnga la khams lnga'i tha snyad kyang mi byed pa shas che/ rigs kyi don la khams zer ba gcig ni yod/ sman dpyad pa dang*/ bzo gnas dang*/ sgra gzhung gi khams sogs rnam bzhag mang po yod mod/ 'di dag dang de dag mi 'dra lags/ gtum mo'i mes snyigs ma'i khams bsregs/ dwangs ma'i khams 'ching rgyu ba'i khams smin zer ba yang brdzun te/

mu stegs lugs la nang pa rnams gtum mo zer ba'i dod kyi ming dang don logs pa zhig yod/ de 'dir mi smra/ gtum mo zer ba'i tha snyad gang na'ang med/ sreg zer ba 'di/ kyai rdor las/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs/ zhes 'byung ba la don ma go bar rigs 'gre sbyar bar 'dug /g.yung drung zor bas pha ske 'breg /ces pa'i dpe de byung 'dug / bsregs zhes pa de'i don bsreg rgyu rang med rgyud kyi brda'i tshig yin/ phyi pa rnams ni/ bsregs pa'i ming don gnyis mi byed lags/ rgyu ba smin zer ba sla ba ska bar song zer rgyur 'dug /khams 'ching ba de dwangs snyigs tshang ma 'ching rgyu yin kyang 'dir dwangs ma'i khams 'ching zer lugs 'dis/ snyigs ma phyi la phud gtong ba'i thabs lam ngo mtshar can rang zhig yod par 'dug go /'dir dwangs ma 'ching zer ba khams thig le lus kyi phyi rol tu mi 'dor ba tsam las go ba lhag po ye ma shar ba'i nyams zhig 'dug /zur tsam smras pas gnas tshul gsal bar go / yang 'di dag so sor sdud kyi 'phros su 'byung ba yang skabs su shin tu ma bab bo/ /tshigs bcad 'di kha'i dbang du byas na/ dben las skyes pa'i bsam gtan rtse gcig pa/ ting nge 'dzin yang yang goms zhes pas/ bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba ma byung go rim kyang*/ rjes dran gyi rjes la bsam gtan byas pa sogs 'khrugs pa dang*/ dus 'khor sbyor drug gi bsam gtan ni so sor sdud pa mthar phyin pa na rim pas skye ste/ de la mngon pa sogs nas bshad pa'i dben pa las skyes pa'i bsam gtan dang po yan lag lnga ldan de dang gcig gam snyam nas/ 'dir yang dben las skyes pa zer ba byas 'dug ste/ de gnyis gcig par 'dod pa rtog nag rgyag /mu stegs pa'i gzhung na yang dben pa las skyes pa zer ba de 'dra mi yong bas/ tshigs bcad 'di phyi pa'i gzhung zer ba yang brdzun gtam mo/ / lar mtshan nyid pa skam po'i zhi lhag gi bshad pa 'ol spyi tsam des kyang gsung rab kyi sgom don rtogs pa dka' zhing rtogs ldan chung ma can gyi kha skad dang*/

rkang dung dang mnyam par sbrags pa'i dpe cha'i nang gi chags lam gyi bshad pas kyang gsang sngags kyi dgos don phyogs tsam yang things pa mi yong lags/ dper na grub thob tu grags pa'i gtsang smyon 'gyur 'bub na/ dga' bzhi'i 'gyur ma yin zer ba dang 'dra dga' bzhi la don dam gyi dga' bzhi/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i dga' bzhi/ 'phags lam gyi dga' bzhi/ sas bsdus pa'i dga' bzhi/ skad cig ma'i dga' bzhi/ phyag rgya bzhi so so la sbyar ba'i dga' bzhi so so/ gzhi'i dga' bzhi rnam gzhan tha dad de dag gnad gcig pa dang tha dad pa sogs mtha' yas pa dang*/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i skyon dang yon tan/ nyon mongs ye shes/ spang gnyen sogs kyi rab dbye ji snyed yod pa gang yang nyams go ma non par/ las rgya la sbyor thengs gcig gi skad cig ma'i dbye ba rab rib cig min pa bshad rgyud 'phongs pa bzhin no/ /rgya gar na phyi pa'i rtsa rlung ba rnams bud med spang byar byed/ rtsa rlung ba chung ma can dang*/ kab li/ rkang dung*/ lag ngar gyi byin rlabs brten la/ kho tsho dga' tshor ye mi byed pa dgongs dgos so/ /des na sbyor drug gi tha snyad lhag med chad med phyi gzhung na yod pa/ nyi zla 'ching ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi lam/ bsam gtan tshad med/ gzugs med snyoms 'jug sogs gleng bslang mang po byung zhes pa yang*/ kho pa la phar bshad gsungs pa yin zer na ma gtogs/ brdzun nyid kho na ste/ de yang bsam gzugs tshad med tsam mu stegs dang thun mong yin zer ba'i kha skad bod la grags pa bon gyer byas pa ste/ de'i don ni sngon mu stegs snyoms 'jug pa mang po bsgoms pas de dag thob pa byung ba'i don yin gyi /mu stegs byed pa'i gzhung lugs gang na yang*/ bsam gzugs tshad med sogs kyi rnam bzhag ye nas med/ ming yang ma grags so/ /'o na ci snyam na/ de yang 'dod chags zhe sdang gi nyes dmigs shes/ chags sdang gi yul la bde ba med par shes/

dpyod pa dang ma bral bar sems rtse gcig pa bsgoms pas/ bsam gtan dang po thob pa yod/ de ka la rgyu sems gnas dgu dang yid byed bdun po tshang yod du chug kyang*/ khos de'i bshad pa shes mi dgos 'chad na'ang 'chad tshul gzhan yod pas so/ kho'i ting nge 'dzin sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu la/ yan lag lnga'i don tshang mod/ sbyor mtha'i ming dang yan lag lnga'i rnam bzhag byed dgos par ma nges te/ gzhan la 'chad dgos srid na'ang*/ 'chad tshul gzhan gyis go nus so/ /des na zhi gnas sgrub pa la/ sems gnas dgu/ nyes pa lnga/ 'du byed brgyad la sogs pa dang*/ bsam gzugs kyi lhag mthong bsgrubs na/ yid byed bdun dang*/ dngos gzhi la bsam gtan gyi yan lag /gzugs med kyi dbye ba tshad med bzhi'i rab dbye/ phan yon nam yon tan la rnam thar brgyad/ zad par bcu/ zil gnon brgyad la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab kho na las 'byung*/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i phar phyin bsdus pa las kyang*/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i bsam gtan zhes/ /gnyis med drang srong mchog gis gsungs/ / zhes sogs kyis dper mtshon no/ / mu stegs snyoms 'jug pa bsam gtan thob pa yang sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum brgya yan la byung srid/ de man nas/ phyi ba la bsam gtan thob pa dang*/ drang srong dka' thub grub pa ma byung*/ nang pa la 'bras bu bzhi thob pa yang ma byung*/ ri dwags rgyal po yang rgyun chad snyigs ma lnga ha cang bdo ba'o/ /zhes 'phags yul ba kun la grags/ des na btsun pa sa ga'i lha yang dgra bcom min/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i dus na/ sing gha la na dgra bcom yod zer ba yang*/ che bar brjod pa tsam du zad do/ / lta ba drug gi mu stegs rnams la bsam gzugs kyi lam thob pa lta zhogarnam bzhag kyang mi 'byung bar ma zad/ lta spyod 'gal ba kho na ste grangs can dang*/ patañdza li ni yul 'dod yon brten pas grol bar 'dod pa yin/ rig can bye brag rig mtha' gsum/

byed po 'dod pas/ de dag la bsam gtan gzugs med kyi lam ga la'o/ /des na 'di pa'i mno tshod la/ bsam gzugs phyi nang thun mong yin byas tsa na/ phyi ba la yang*/ mdzod kyi gnas brgyad pa lta bu'i bsam gzugs kyi rnam bzhag yod yong snyam pa zhig byung 'dug ste phyogs bslad pa yin/ da lta mu stegs pa su la yang bsam gzugs thob pa lta zhogade'i gdams ngag yang med/ gzhung yang med/ snyoms 'jug pa'i brgyud 'dzin du rlom pa'i rigs kyang ci yang med lags/ sngon snyoms 'jug thob pa yod pa'i dus kyang rang rang gis thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin de thar par rlom pa yin pas/ de'i gong na gzhan yod par mi 'dod do/ /dper na blun po dag mda' 'phang ba dang*/ zhing las dang*/ tshong dang*/ 'khrig thabs dang*/ g.yul 'gyed pa'i bya ba shes kyang*/ de dag gi rnam bzhag dang bshad pa dang*/ bstan bcos mi shes pa bzhin no/ / yang a ma ra nas 'byung zer ba ni stobs dang mngon shes ni/ a marakoṣa las bshad/ bden bzhi dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi der yong don rang ni mi bdog /kho pa de paṇ+ḍita yin na/ rtog ge'i 'grel pa na/ phyogs snga'i tshul du/ nang pa'i grub mtha' 'ol tsam bshad pa ni yod 'dug /yang khyed cag bdag med smra ba yin/ tha snyad 'gog gam don dam 'gog ces 'dri ba ni bden na blun po'i dri ba ste/ bdag med par 'dod phyin/ gzhan lugs kyi bdag 'gog na don 'gog pa la the tshom ci yod/ don bkag phyin dgos pa zur khyad yod na ma gtogs tha snyad kyang 'gog pa las lags/ rang rang lugs la yang thal 'gyur ba rnying pa tsho ma gtogs bdag med kyi don sgrub pa las 'os ci/ zer lugs 'di ni gcig du bral gyis chos kyi bdag 'gog pa'i skabs tshul gsum so sor grub dus rang bzhin med pa'i don grub zin pas/ sgrub ngag 'god dus tha snyad sgrub par 'gro zer ba kho la dpe blangs pa'i zhib cha yin rgyu'i khungs byas pa de kar gda'/

'brel shin tu chung*/ yang 'dir kha cig gi bsam pa la/ bdag yod ces smra ba phyi rol pa dang*/ med ces smra ba sangs rgyas pa'o snyam du sems mod ces bris te/ de 'dra sems can gyi nang na srid mnyam na ni srid shas che/ gzhan de 'dra rang cher med dam/ yang bdag gi tha snyad khas blangs pas phyi rol par 'gro na ston pa yang der thal/ tha snyad khas ma blangs pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas par 'gro na/ bya dang ri dwags der thal zer ba yang 'brel med g.yas chung ste/ lar phyogs snga med pa'i thal 'gyur 'dis ci bya/ 'on kyang 'dir dpyad de/ bdag gi tha snyad khas mi len pa'i grub mtha' smra ba rang su yang yod mi thang*/ khas len zer ba de grub mtha' khas len pa la zer ba yin pas/ 'jig tshogs lta dang bral yang sangs rgyas kyi/ /ji ltar nga dang nga yir bstan pa ltar/ /de bzhin dngos rnams rang bzhin med mod kyi/ /yod ces drang don nyid du bstan pa yin/ /zer ba de tsam gyis ston pas bdag gi tha snyad zhal gyis bzhes par ta mi 'gro/ lar gyi 'jug pa'i tshig de yang mi 'thad de/ dngos po rnams yod par gsungs pa'i mdo/ sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa'i drang don yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi nga nyid de'i tshe bya ba dang*/ nga'i nyan thos zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra zer rgyur 'dug pa la don du ni/ rgyal bas de ltar gsungs pa de sgra ji bzhin pa yin gyi/ gzhan du drang zhing bsgyur ba mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /

nang pa rnams kyang bdag gi tha snyad du ma zad/ don yang khas len pa sha stag ste/ kha cig gdags gzhi phung po spyi btags pa'i btags yod dang*/ kha cig yid shes la btags pa'i btags yod dang*/ la la kun gzhi la btags par 'dod/ nga bdag gtan med ma yin/ btags yod du 'dod pas yod pa'i rnam grangs kho na yin la/ de dag la mi 'thad pa yang cher med/ nang pa'i nyan thos sde pa lnga bdag rdzas grub tu 'dod pa tsho mi 'thad pa yin/ shes bya la gtan nas mi srid pa'i bdag de/ rtag gcig rang dbang can la zer/ 'di kun btags kho na yin ces phal cher zer ba mi 'thad/ lhan skyes kyis kyang 'di kho nar rlom pa yin/ des na mu stegs kyi grub mthas btags pa'i kun btags tsho yang*/ lhan skyes rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa yin/ bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi 'dzin stangs kyis bzung ba ltar shes bya mi srid pa yin no/ / 'di'i chos skad zar zur 'di tsho la dpags na/ mi nag pa chos skad gyal gyol smra mkhan gyi tshig gam/ khams 'khrugs shing smyos pa gcig gi tshig rang yin pa 'dra'o/ / shog ril 'di ni/ mchog sprul dam pa de'i gsung ma yin par ma zad de bskur 'debs rang los yin/ lar rje de nyid 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i dus kyang sde dpon so so'i sa dang rgyal khams tha dad du mi sna yong mkhan rnams kyis/ gsung ma yin pa la yin par rdzu ba'i shog dril re khyer nas ga ge mo yin/ che che mo yin/ ched du brjod pa yin ces 'phral 'phral rang yong ba zhig yod/ de la grwa rigs yon bdag tshos che ba sgrog gang thub byas pa na/ ma dad pa tshos bskur pa mang po byed cing*/ zhwa dmar can gyi zhal gzigs dang*/ /zhwa dmar can gyi lung bstan 'dra ang zer brnyas bcos 'ba' zhig byed/ de phyogs 'dzin pa tshos mi bzod par/ shags rgod dang kha 'thab 'phral 'phral 'ong zhing*/ re 'ga' lag thug yong du cha ba yang byung*/ bla ma'i zhabs thog tu bsams nas byas par 'dug kyang*/

bla ma'i zhabs 'dren dang*/ mi mang po'i sdig gsog gi rgyur 'gro ba zhig sngar yang yang byung bas/ phyag g.yog dang grwa rigs yi ge dang spor/ rtsom dga' tshod pa la yon tan go ba rab be rib be 'dra tsho bag yod la 'khod na mdzes so// de nas paṇ+ḍi tas zer ba man chad ni de ka mthus pa 'dug lags/ 'dir gong du nyi zla 'ching zer ba/ phyi'am nang gang yin 'dri/ rdzu 'phrul gyi lam zer ba la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi skad dod ṛd+dhi la zer na/ phyi pa dang nang pa ngos 'dzin mi gcig lags/ de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi dh+ya na la yang go ba mi gcig pa sogs du ma yod de da lam 'dir phyogs tsam zur tsam smos pa yin/ 'di'i khungs don gsal por ston dgos na/ yi ge mang du dgos pa 'dug lags/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas g.yar khral lo// //zhus so/ /maṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dogs gcod mun sel bzhugs/ - PAGE 68 - - PAGE 69 -- PAGE 39 -
